program.section_heading: LVN to Registered Nursing Associate of Science
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will utilize the nursing process and evidence-based practice to facilitate optimal client outcomes for diverse cultures across the lifespan and in a variety of settings.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and attitudes required of the professional nurse as defined by the California Nursing Practice Act, standards of nursing practice, considering legal, moral, and ethical principles.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will communicate and collaborate effectively in both oral and written formats, employing patient care technologies and information systems with individuals, families, populations, communities, and the interdisciplinary team across the health care continuum.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will collaborate with healthcare professionals to enhance quality improvement and safety initiatives at individual and systems levels of care.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will assume the roles of provider of care, manager of care, and member of the profession as an entry-level nurse.
careers: Employment in a variety of healthcare facilities and settings

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., NURSB44); these match closed-list codes NURS B44, NURS B46, NURS B49, NURS B51 and are marked catalog_addition false.
NURSB80C (Nursing Learning Lab 3, 0.5) and NURSB80D (Nursing Learning Lab 4, 0.5) are not in the closed list and are recorded as catalog additions.
The printed course units sum to 18, matching the stated total of 18 for both the program and the Core Courses block.

The only career text is the single line 'Employment in a variety of healthcare facilities and settings' under Career Opportunities; it is recorded as printed, though it is a general field rather than a job title.

Each program learning outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will'. This phrase is part of each printed outcome, so it is kept; only the list numbers were removed.
No general education pattern is named in the text.
